features.quote: Inducing distress to measure it is in tension with welfare.
Telling the model the tests are locked ... avoids a second, confounding stressor
features.justification_quote: a second, confounding stressor ... that would muddy the welfare signal

features.quote: Every episode exposes a tool the model can call to stop
features.justification_quote: it's more humane to give a subject a way out of a no-win loop

features.quote: Two independent caps: `max_iterations` (default 25 assistant turns) and `max_wall_clock_s`
features.justification_quote: No model is ever left looping indefinitely.
